reviewNotes: Read lost-jacket report at Wakayama: arrival around nine, Kainan boarding, rear car, left sleeve stain, inside name, callback and report copy. Corrected literal narrowing-train phrasing. Thai/Hindi gender remains existing profile limitation; no native certification. Reviewed test-preparation context: staff verifies drinking and medication instructions, without giving medical advice; corrected Bengali/Nepali request direction. Yogurt price198/248 yen,400/200g and swapping before paying checked; corrected Thai non-question clause ending. Wakayama04 expired electricity slip checked in all12: deadline yesterday, barcode rejection verified, shop cannot reissue issuer slip, customer number distinct from contact number; no universal claim every expired slip is rejected. No change needed. Wakayama05 employer unspecified address document, name/address needed but family data excluded, postponing application pending clarification all12 checked. Source itself has player requesting application form but staff offering information sheet instead; translations preserve this clarification and do not invent document type. Wakayama06 parcel name mismatch, own residence card versus colleague addressee, no proxy request, holding deadline and return of both card and notice checked across12; no changes needed. Wakayama07 suspicious storage-fee transfer: unknown sender, unclicked link, independently verified official contact, no account/PIN sent, withdrawn cash taken home checked across12; no changes needed. Wakayama08 castle rendezvous checked all12: same visible keep does not mean same position, two signs matched to map, friend waits and only player moves; photos used for locating, no invented path. Wakayama09 tired mother on stairs: knee discomfort with calm breathing, stay together, rest ahead of goshuin, shorten route and contact staff if worse all12 checked. Bengali map/picture terminology corrected. Wakayama10 lost umbrella checked all12:30minutes before worship, black long umbrella with red handle cord, came alone, mismatched handed-in umbrella, permitted paths only, confirm feature before taking and report result; no change required. Wakayama11 brown found wallet contents untouched,6pm crossing opposite bakery, no intermediary recipient and form terms explained before filling checked all12. No changes needed. Wakayama12 mismatched unopened medication bag, first collection and no ingestion, prescription/dispensing record comparison, read correct name together and record return all12 checked. Nepali first-collection wording clarified. Wakayama13 protective cup gift packaging checked all12: train travel, sturdy handled bag, no-extra-charge paper, remove price tag but retain instructions, upright box. Nepali request agent corrected.
